issues.quote: He has a history of noise exposure and uses one hearing aid inconsistently; a screening sheet lists left-ear thresholds of 45 dB at 500 Hz and 50 dB at 1000 Hz, but provides no right-ear values or results at 2000 and 3000 Hz. He reports no hearing loss in quiet conversation, yet repeatedly asks the nurse to repeat questions when a fan is running, and there is no signed audiologist assessment.

source_observations.quote: The driver initially ticks no blackouts and explains that he sometimes misses radio messages because of reduced hearing, but later describes a delivery during which his colleague waved in front of him for several seconds before he responded; he remembers hearing the engine and seeing the loading bay, although he cannot recall the spoken exchange. The colleague believes he was briefly unaware, while the driver thinks his hearing aid battery had failed, and neither account establishes whether consciousness was lost.
source_observations.explanation: The note does not explicitly state whether the blackout occurred, so the status is uncertain.
